source.snippet: A consultant setting up Microsoft Entra ID SSO for an Apache HTTPD client: 'there is no clear and concise instructions on how to do this... the sample config file is about 929 lines and is not [helpful].' Client is actively trying to implement paid enterprise SSO.

problem_statement: IT consultants and sysadmins integrating Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) SSO with non-Microsoft web servers like Apache face extremely poor documentation and no guided setup tooling, causing billable hours to be wasted.
target_segment: IT consultants and sysadmins managing web infrastructure for SMB/enterprise clients using Microsoft Entra ID
notes: Explicit business context: consultant working for a paying client. Microsoft Entra ID is a paid enterprise product — this is firmly in the professional/billable-hours space. A guided setup wizard or config generator for Apache+Entra SSO could be sold as a tool or service. Pain is concrete and the 929-line config file is a memorable friction point.
